entities.name: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reductase
observations: The 432-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt C0R0B8, with 100% identity and coverage.
The protein belongs to the Aldedh domain family (PF00171), consistent with aldehyde dehydrogenase-like catalytic chemistry.
Curated annotations assign cytoplasmic localization, NADP binding, and glutamate-5-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity.

entities.name: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reduction
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the NADPH-dependent reduction of L-glutamate 5-phosphate to L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde and phosphate.
L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde spontaneously cyclizes to 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate, linking the reaction to L-proline biosynthesis.

entities.name: L-proline biosynthesis
observations: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reductase performs the second step in conversion of L-glutamate to L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde in the L-proline biosynthetic pathway.
